proposals.statement: Parents struggle to get information from the school because fee statements are printed and sent home in learners' bags but half never reach parents

evidence.quote: Fee statements are printed every month and sent home in the learners' bags, and half of them never reach the parents.

proposals.statement: Parents phone the school about fees because they don't receive fee statements

evidence.quote: Then I have parents phoning me about fees.

proposals.statement: Reports are printed, put in envelopes, and sent home but take a week of admin staff's time every term for 900 learners

evidence.quote: For about 900 learners, that's a week of the admin staff's time every term.

proposals.statement: Absence notes are handwritten in the learner's homework diary or emailed to the class teacher who may not pass them to the office, causing a learner to be marked absent for three days without the office knowing

evidence.quote: We had a learner marked absent for three days last term and nobody at the office knew why.

proposals.statement: The portal must allow parents to see their current balance, monthly fee statements as PDFs, and EFT reference numbers

evidence.quote: The current balance, the monthly statement as a PDF, and the reference to use for EFT.

proposals.statement: The portal must provide term reports as PDFs released on the same day for all parents

evidence.quote: The term report as a PDF, the same one we print. Released on the same day for everyone.

proposals.statement: The portal must deliver school notices from the office and grade heads to the whole school or specific groups

evidence.quote: Notices from the office and from the grade heads, either to the whole school or just to one grade or one team.

proposals.statement: The portal must allow parents to report their child's absence with a reason and dates, visible to the class teacher and office immediately

evidence.quote: the reason and the dates, and the class teacher and the office, both see it straight away.

proposals.statement: The school uses Schoolbase 7 from about 2014, which holds learners, parents' fees, and marks and produces report PDFs

evidence.quote: It's Schoolbase 7 from about 2014, I think. It holds the learners, the parents' fees and marks. It can export to CSV, and it produces the report PDFs.

proposals.statement: The portal must be lightweight with small pages and PDFs only downloaded when opened to accommodate parents with limited data plans

evidence.quote: the portal has to be light, small pages, and the PDFs only downloaded when someone actually opens one.

proposals.statement: The data must be hosted in South Africa as per the board's requirement

evidence.quote: The board said it must be hosted in South Africa. That came out of the last board meeting.

proposals.statement: The portal should use the school's maroon color instead of a generic blue

evidence.quote: Oh, and please use the school's maroon, not some generic blue.

proposals.statement: The portal should support Isi Zulu for notices and main screens to accommodate grandparents who are more comfortable in Isi Zulu

evidence.quote: If the notices and the main screens could be in Isi Zulu too, that would mean a lot.

proposals.statement: The portal should have big, clear text and be accessible to users with visual impairments using screen readers

evidence.quote: big, clear text. Some of our parents struggle with their eyesight. And we have a blind parent on the PTA who uses a screen reader.

proposals.statement: The finance committee has proposed 250,000 rand for the first year, but the board must approve it

evidence.quote: The finance committee has proposed 250,000 rand for the first year. All in. But the board has to approve it.

proposals.statement: Only a learner's own parents or guardians may see information about that learner, with court orders for some files

evidence.quote: Only a learner's own parents or guardians may see anything about that learner.

evidence.quote: The board said it must be hosted in South Africa. That came out of the last board meeting.

evidence.quote: If the notices and the main screens could be in Isi Zulu too, that would mean a lot.

proposals.statement: The portal must have large, clear text for users with vision difficulties

evidence.quote: big, clear text. Some of our parents struggle with their eyesight.

proposals.statement: The project must be ready by the 26th of June for Term 2 reports

evidence.quote: The Term 2 reports go out on the 26th of June. We'd like parents to get those through the portal.

proposals.statement: The school has 1,650 parent contacts, not 1,400 as previously thought

evidence.quote: It's not 1,400 parent contacts. It's about 1,650. A lot of families have both parents and a grandparent listed.

proposals.statement: If the first report day goes poorly, parents may lose trust in the portal immediately

evidence.quote: A risk I see is that if the first report day goes badly, parents lose trust in the portal straight away.

proposals.statement: The project will start with a trial for Grade 8 Term 1 reports in April

evidence.quote: Let's do grade 8 in April as the trial.

proposals.statement: The school's IT person is only available two days a week

evidence.quote: I'm the only IT person and only two days a week.

proposals.statement: Booking slots for parents' evenings is planned for later, not the first version

evidence.quote: Eventually, booking slots for parents' evenings. But not now.
